Method of Attack: Browser-based cryptomining script injected by redirecting HTTP proxy settings to an attacker-controlled error page
Mining operation attempted via web mining for all proxy traffic on compromised devices
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2018-14847 vulnerability in Winbox management component allowing remote authentication bypass and arbitrary file read
Indicators of Compromise: Traffic forwarded to IP addresses including 37.1.207.114 and 95.154.216.128/25 block (notably 95.154.216.167)
Malicious Socks4 proxy configured on compromised devices
Scheduled task reporting device IP to attacker-controlled URL
Redirected HTTP proxy settings to attacker-created error page hosting mining script
